name: PayHaze for WooCommerce
author: payhaze

sections.description:
Connect your PayHaze account in one click, and your customers can pay by card.

  • One-click connection. Sign in to PayHaze, authorize your shop, come back: the key and the notification address are created for you. A pasted API key works too.
  • Nothing loads on your shop pages. Card details are typed on the PayHaze page, never on your site. The extension adds no script outside the checkout.
  • No lost order. Orders follow signed PayHaze notifications; when a notification cannot reach your site, the shop asks PayHaze itself every 5 minutes.
  • Refunds from WooCommerce, with the usual Refund button.
  • Collect when the order ships: the card is held when ordering and charged when the order becomes Completed.
  • Saved cards for returning customers.
  • PayHaze subscriptions: PayHaze runs the schedule, invoices and retries; each paid renewal becomes a WooCommerce order to ship.
  • Classic and block checkout, and WooCommerce order tables (HPOS).

The extension takes payments in euros. Payments go to the payment account you connected in PayHaze; saved cards and subscriptions need a Stripe account connected in PayHaze.

External services

This extension connects to PayHaze (https://payhaze.com), the payment service you use to collect orders.

  • When you connect the shop, check the connection, or disconnect: your shop address, name and notification address are sent to PayHaze.
  • When a customer pays: the order number, amount, currency, your customer’s account number and, for subscriptions, their name and email are sent to PayHaze. Card details are typed on the PayHaze page, not on your shop.
  • PayHaze sends notifications to your shop about payments, refunds and subscriptions.

PayHaze terms: https://payhaze.com/conditions — privacy policy: https://payhaze.com/confidentialite
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the extension. WooCommerce must be active and your shop currency set to euro.
  2. Go to WooCommerce › Settings › Payments › PayHaze.
  3. Click “Connect my PayHaze account”, sign in, and authorize your shop.
sections.faq:
Do card details go through my site?

No. Customers type them on the PayHaze page.

My host blocks notifications. Will I lose orders?

No. “Check that everything works” tells you when notifications are blocked, and the shop asks PayHaze itself every 5 minutes until the payment is settled.

Can a subscription include shipping?

Include it in the subscription price: the first payment must equal the subscription price.
